_comment: METRICS 6.9 and 6.11, checked by spec/tools/task_score.py and generated from spec/tools/task_score_cases.py (--write). Events are the normalised stream of 6.9 (prompt / action with kind, tool, digest, command, outcome, failures, hunks); an outcome whose `t` is after a query's `nowMs` is not known yet. `continuations`: is the text a continuation. `promptLines`: the prompt kind of one line of a source (`t`: the prompt's own time when it is not the line's, a queued Claude message). `segmentation`: prompt events from classified lines. `tasks`: the current task of a stream at `nowMs` (absent: everything): state, score (unrounded), shown (half away from zero), the five dimensions, IG, loop and oscillation shares, counts, first pass, stall window ends and the task facts vHeld, openFailure and lastPass. `values`: agent forms and the highest-score rule for groups and the whole set (agent `weight` is ignored on purpose). `predictions`: P(success), P(stall), P(fix fails) of the current task with the given or prior coefficients. `records`: the task records of a whole stream. `calibration`: per source and model, coefficients (tolerance 1e-6), flag and task count, and probe probabilities. `comparison`: the aggregates over a date range (and one source when `source` is given). `thinking`: the live thinking line (6.9 Live thinking): liveThinking, thinkingShare and the window weight of the set, every agent and every board group.

segmentation.name: prompts take effect at once; a continuation keeps its flag
a local command is withdrawn by its output
a prompt command is confirmed by the model's reply; later output does nothing
a copied prompt (its first reply is a duplicate) is withdrawn
command output never withdraws a prompt

tasks.name: none: reading only has no score
unverified: edits without a check stay low (E only)
an edit then a full test pass; before its result the task is unverified
convergence 5 → 2 → pass, recovered on the second attempt
pending: an edit after a pass takes V and K away until the check runs again
regression: a check that passed fails after an edit
regression penalty: a new failure after a decrease counts twice
loop: the same failing test re-run without an edit
oscillation: an edit that reverts an earlier one
whole-file writes: an earlier version oscillates, the same content changes nothing
a failed edit changes nothing: still passing
a build-only pass is worth half of V
pending after a build-only pass holds 20
a failure without counts: one error, not counted
verification without an edit (run the tests and report)
a targeted fix, then the full suite
a continuation keeps the task; a new prompt starts with no score
a passing check does not hide a failing test
failed, then edited: still failing until the check runs again
an unknown outcome is not a run; counts alone can make a pass
exit 0 with reported failures is a failure (piped output)
a piped build that reports no error passes; a test summary that ran nothing is no run
stall: eight actions in a row that find almost nothing new
an `other` tool neither counts nor breaks a loop

values.name: agent forms: live while working, resting while idle, none without a score
the highest live score wins even when a lower one writes far more tokens
no live score: the highest resting score
groups: live max over members, else resting max, else none; ties by latest activity, then id

predictions.name: a passing task with the prior coefficients
a failing task: P(fix fails) from its latest failing run
failed, then edited: the fix features stay those of the failing run
calibrated coefficients are used as given

records.name: a whole stream: an implicit first task, a continuation, an empty prompt, a stall; the last task is still open
the last task is complete once the agent has been quiet for 30 minutes

calibration.name: a synthetic history: codex has enough tasks, claudeCode keeps the prior
one outcome only: the success model stays on the prior

comparison.name: per source and per model over a range; open tasks and days outside are left out
one source chosen in the window's picker
quartiles and histogram bins at their edges; a model across sources
no scored task: no quartiles, an empty histogram

windows.name: a measured response: grade plus 20 × its thinking share
models weigh by their output in the window; an orb counts its own sources
an in-flight agent is estimated with its reference set's speed and thinking share
DeepSeek Harness adds its grade but not to the thinking share
an unmeasured response is estimated like an in-flight agent
unknown model and effort count as standard and medium; reasoning is capped at output

agentWindows.name: a generating agent counts its measured response and its in-flight estimate; an idle agent rests on its grade; a generating agent without a model or an estimate has none
two agents of one source: each shows its own value and the source blends them; at rest an agent shows the grade of its current effort
a sub-agent is an agent of its own: its parent's value never includes it; an unmeasured response counts for its own agent
an agent without a model is live while its estimate exists, from another agent's responses; it has no grade of its own and weighs as an unknown model
an agent's grade takes the provider of its latest response that names one

groupWindows.name: a group row weighs its root and every sub-agent by the tokens they write, never an average of their values; at rest it shows the root's grade, not that of the sub-agent active last
a group whose root has no model is live from its sub-agents' estimate and has no value at rest, even when a sub-agent has a grade; a sub-agent whose parent is not listed heads its own group

modelWindows.name: every model weighs by its own responses' output in the window, never by the agent that wrote them

an in-flight estimate goes to the agent's current model, its finished response to the response's own; a source without separate reasoning adds weight and no share; an agent without an estimate adds nothing
